items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: The shared neutral theme, Geist, radius and dark mode.

items.name: transport
items.title: Transport
items.description: Same-origin reads with ETag, 15-second polling and focus refresh; invalidation of all reads or by path prefix; commands with CSRF and an idempotency key; event streams that reconnect and resume from the last id; last good data kept on error.

items.name: route
items.title: Hash routes
items.description: #view/parts?query routes, so every page and filter state is a link.

items.name: use-sortable
items.title: Sortable rows
items.description: Three-state column sorting with numeric-aware comparison.

items.name: use-shortcuts
items.title: Keyboard shortcuts
items.description: Screen shortcuts that never fire while the user is typing or a modifier is held.

items.name: shell
items.title: Shell parts
items.description: Section, Stat, ErrorBanner, Empty, Loading, Out, CopyLine, StateBadge, SortHead, Pager, Kv, StatusDot, UsageBar, Move, ConfirmDialog and the formatters.

items.name: frame
items.title: App frame
items.description: Collapsible sidebar, sticky header with breadcrumb title and signed-in person, a status line, and an error boundary per screen. An app supplies its nav, and may group it under labels, give a record its own scoped nav with a way back, add an aside that persists across screens (a bottom bar and sheet on phones), and set the status line, header contents, widths and crumbs.

items.name: views
items.title: View switch
items.description: Alternate views of one screen: remembered, shareable in the address, small.

items.name: layout
items.title: Layouts as data
items.description: A screen names its parts; a layout arranges them in rows and columns and can live in a JSON file. Unknown parts or grids are rejected.

items.name: screen-overview
items.title: Overview screen
items.description: What needs the operator, then the state of the system.

items.name: screen-list
items.title: List screen
items.description: Filtered, sortable, server-paged list with a detail sheet and a phone layout; all state in the address.

items.name: screen-review
items.title: Review queue screen
items.description: One item at a time, bounded verbs, keyboard shortcuts, undo.

items.name: screen-runs
items.title: Runs screen
items.description: Run history, starting a run behind a confirmation that states its cost, and one run in its own scoped nav: summary, submissions and log.

items.name: screen-settings
items.title: Settings screen
items.description: Small forms saved by commands, plus copyable terminal commands.
